data.text: **Question:** Design a chat application like WhatsApp.
Key features: real-time messaging, group chats, media sharing, read receipts. Use WebSockets for real-time, message queues for delivery, and media storage for files.
Architecture: WebSocket gateway for real-time, message service for storage, presence service, media service. Use message queues for offline delivery. Store messages in time-series database.
